children: Spire Global said it received a two-year, $33.2 million task order from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.
The satellite data and analytics company said the agreement covers the delivery of global navigation satellite system radio occultation data. The task order is effective beginning in December.
The agreement includes unfunded surge-buy options that, if fully exercised, could bring its total potential value to around $66 million, Spire said.

The task order is part of an indefinite delivery, indefinite quantity NOAA contract for commercial environmental satellite data with a shared $8 billion ceiling. Spire said it is eligible for future task orders across the contract's five-year base period.
The company had previously received a similar $3.7 million contract from NOAA to provide GNSS-RO data running through Dec. 1.
